nom: Clarins UV Plus Anti-Pollution Tinted Face Sunscreen SPF 50

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or drier skin, including one in Florida, report it protects and adds glow without emphasizing dryness, though one dry, sensitive-skinned user calls the product vital for daily comfort.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skinned reviewers, including one self-described redhead and one who is very sun-sensitive, repeatedly single out this product as the only sunscreen that doesn't sting their eyes or irritate their skin, though others with sensitive skin report a new fragrance causing sneezing, dizziness or a rash.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin reports over ten years of use with no breakouts.
segments.mature: Reviewers who describe their skin as mature or in their 50s-60s report it gives glow and light coverage without settling into fine lines or wrinkles, while one 2-star review says the fragrance version settled into her lines and aged her look.
segments.oily: One reviewer notes it is not ideal for very oily skin, while others say it controls shine and leaves no oily feel.

concerns.aging: Most mature or older reviewers say it does not enhance wrinkles and gives a glow appropriate for 50+ skin; one dissenting reviewer says the newer, fragranced formula settled into her lines and made her look older.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating, non-drying and leaving skin soft and moisturized.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including ones describing red cheeks or general redness, say it does not irritate or burn the skin; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Some longtime users report no irritation for years, but a subset describe a recent reaction, rash, or eye irritation they attribute to a reformulation.
concerns.spots: Long-term users report fading dark spots and reduced visible sun damage or freckling; no negative reports on spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Two reviewers with otherwise positive experience report the product clogged pores and caused breakouts; one long-term combination-skin user reports no breakouts at all.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers say it controls oily-feeling skin and leaves no greasy residue, though one notes it is not ideal for very oily skin types.

aspects.libelle: Shade runs orange or leaves white cast
Good value given multi-use as sunscreen/foundation

extraits.titre: Caused breakouts, would be 5 stars otherwise
extraits.texte: I loved the feel when applying and the look this had on my skin. The color was such a great match. Unfortunately it clogged my pores and caused breakouts. I was disappointed as otherwise this would be a 5 star product for me.

I have been using this product for years on a daily basis and have loved everything about it. It has even faded dark spots on my face so that they don't exist anymore. I just opened and used a new bottle this morning, and there is a fragrance that is making me sneeze. I see where another reviewer made a similar comment about the fragrance. I have never had a fragrance problem with any Clarins face products, so this is a huge disappointment. I may, sadly, have to find a new face sunblock.
This is my all time facial sunscreen and it's the best for my very sensitive skin.I love the products very much.
